title: Model cache dependency cuts
outcome: Split committed and saved; unlanded pending the pilot helper fix.
changes: Inventory all 17 composite model caches and the other structural caches before edits, with readers by part.

Split standing, seat membership, presence, parent placement, resident facts and labels, attention, progress, continuation, session retention and links, and header answers into independent cached questions.
Keep uncached compatibility records where existing callers need a record; reading one property observes its own cached answer.
Remove sidebar.parent because the shared nestParent answer replaces its parent-ID projection.
Pass through the maintained R2 roster list; preserve the existing sidebar resident-demand observation policy.
Keep unknown-row progress defaults at zero even while a formal child remains resident, with a meaningful removal regression.
